shared_elements: low-relief carved figures with detailed patterned garments
figures shown striding with one foot forward
procession-like arrangement of figures along a surface
hair and beard rendered as regular curled rows
justification: Both surfaces show bearded human figures in strict profile, striding with long pleated/fringed robes, rendered in shallow relief with hair and beard as regular rows of curls, and both include a conventionalized tree/plant among the figures. The biggest difference is composition and content: A is a single large winged genius filling one panel beside a stylized tree, while B is a multi-register procession of many small unwinged figures leading animals along horizontal bands.
